players.product: diesel standby gensets (95 L / QSK95) and QSK60 / HSK78 natural gas gensets for data centers; 130 L natural gas prime-power genset in development

quarterly_data.signal: Cummins' Q2 2026 earnings release segment sales data (in millions): Power Systems segment power generation product-line sales were $1,536 in Q2 2026 versus $1,205 in Q2 2025, and Distribution segment power generation product-line sales were $1,378 versus $1,200; Power Systems segment EBITDA was $552 versus $430. The release attributes Distribution's growth to increased demand for power generation products, particularly for data center applications.
quarterly_data.figure: Power Systems power generation sales $1,536 million (Q2 2026) vs $1,205 million (Q2 2025); Distribution power generation sales $1,378 million vs $1,200 million; Power Systems EBITDA $552 million vs $430 million

quarterly_data.signal: The Q2 2026 release states that deliveries under the June agreement with Circe Energy — a series of HSK78 and QSK60 natural gas generator sets for a scalable, behind-the-meter prime power microgrid at Circe's High-Performance Computing data center in Texas — are scheduled from 2026 through 2030.
